course.title: Full Stack Web Development Mastery
course.goal: Transform absolute beginners into internship-ready Full Stack Developers.
course.workflow: Learn → Practice → Git → Build → Deploy → Showcase

days.title: HTML Fundamentals
practicalTasks: Create a basic personal introduction page using headings and paragraphs.
Add a list of your hobbies and favorite movies with external links.
Embed an image and a YouTube video into your page.

assignment.title: Build a Wikipedia Clone Page
assignment.description: Recreate a Wikipedia article layout using only HTML. Must include semantic tags like header, main, section, aside, and footer.

miniProject.title: Personal Portfolio Wireframe (HTML Only)
miniProject.description: Build the skeleton of your personal portfolio.

days.badgeCriteria: Complete Day 1 assignment with semantic tags.

days.title: HTML Advanced + Forms
practicalTasks: Build a basic login form with email and password inputs.
Create a complex HTML table for a class schedule.
Build a multi-step survey form with radio buttons and checkboxes.

assignment.title: Registration Form UI
assignment.description: Create a comprehensive user registration form capturing personal details, preferences, and account setup information.

miniProject.title: Restaurant Menu & Booking Form
miniProject.description: Build a restaurant page with a menu table and a table reservation form.

days.badgeCriteria: Successfully submit the Registration Form UI via GitHub.

days.title: CSS Fundamentals
practicalTasks: Style the Day 1 portfolio skeleton with custom fonts and colors.
Demonstrate the Box Model by styling three distinct boxes.
Create a styled button component with hover states.

assignment.title: Styling the Registration Form
assignment.description: Apply CSS to the Day 2 registration form to make it visually appealing and user-friendly.

miniProject.title: Styled Product Card
miniProject.description: Create an e-commerce product card with an image, title, price, and 'Add to Cart' button.

days.badgeCriteria: Score 100% on the CSS Box Model Quiz.

days.title: Responsive Design + Flexbox + Grid
objectives: Make websites responsive with Media Queries
practicalTasks: Build a flexible navigation bar using Flexbox.
Create a 3-column photo gallery using CSS Grid.
Write media queries to make the gallery stack vertically on mobile.

assignment.title: Responsive Dashboard Layout
assignment.description: Build a responsive dashboard layout with a sidebar (Grid) and a top navigation bar (Flexbox).

miniProject.title: Responsive Portfolio Page
miniProject.description: Upgrade your HTML portfolio into a fully responsive, styled webpage.

days.badgeCriteria: Deploy the Responsive Portfolio Page and submit the live URL.

days.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
practicalTasks: Write a function that calculates the area of a rectangle.
Use a loop to print all even numbers from 1 to 50.
Build a simple calculator using functions and switch statements.

assignment.title: JavaScript Logic Puzzles
assignment.description: Solve 5 algorithmic challenges (e.g., FizzBuzz, Reverse String, Palindrome Check).

miniProject.title: Interactive Quiz Logic
miniProject.description: Write the core logic for a multiple-choice quiz using JS arrays and objects (no UI yet).

days.badgeCriteria: Complete the Logic Puzzles with all test cases passing.

days.title: Advanced JavaScript + DOM + APIs
practicalTasks: Create a button that changes the background color of the page on click.
Use array methods to filter a list of users by age.
Fetch and display a random joke from a public API.

assignment.title: DOM Manipulation Task Tracker
assignment.description: Build a simple To-Do list where users can add, cross out, and delete tasks using pure JS.

miniProject.title: API-based Weather App
miniProject.description: Build a weather application that fetches data from the OpenWeatherMap API and displays it in the DOM.

days.badgeCriteria: Successfully fetch and render data from a public API.

days.title: Git & GitHub Workflow
practicalTasks: Initialize a Git repository and make your first commit.
Create a new branch, make changes, and merge it into main.
Push a local repository to GitHub.

assignment.title: Open Source Contribution Simulation
assignment.description: Fork a repository, create a feature branch, make a meaningful change, and open a Pull Request.

miniProject.title: Portfolio Deployment via GitHub Pages
miniProject.description: Host your Day 4 portfolio on GitHub Pages.

days.badgeCriteria: Successfully merge a Pull Request and host on GitHub pages.

days.title: React Fundamentals
practicalTasks: Create a 'Hello World' React component.
Pass data from a parent component to a child component using props.
Build a simple counter using the useState hook.

assignment.title: React Component Library
assignment.description: Build a set of reusable UI components (Button, Card, Input) in React using props for customization.

miniProject.title: React Todo App
miniProject.description: Rebuild the Day 6 Todo App using React State and Components.

days.badgeCriteria: Complete the React Todo App assignment.

days.title: React Intermediate + Routing
practicalTasks: Use useEffect to log a message when a component mounts.
Set up a multi-page app with React Router (Home, About, Contact).
Fetch API data inside useEffect and store it in state.

assignment.title: Movie Search Application
assignment.description: Build an app that searches for movies using the OMDB API and displays details on a separate route.

miniProject.title: E-Commerce Frontend
miniProject.description: Build a product listing page and a shopping cart page using React Router and Context API.

days.title: Tailwind CSS + UI Building
practicalTasks: Rebuild the Day 3 Button component using only Tailwind classes.
Create a responsive navigation bar in Tailwind.
Implement a dark mode toggle switch.

assignment.title: Gamified Dashboard UI
assignment.description: Build the frontend UI for a student dashboard displaying XP, levels, and enrolled courses using Tailwind CSS.

miniProject.title: Landing Page Clone
miniProject.description: Clone the homepage of a popular SaaS product (like Stripe or Vercel) using React and Tailwind.

days.title: Node.js + Express.js
practicalTasks: Set up a basic Express server that responds with 'Hello World'.
Create GET and POST routes for a '/users' endpoint.
Write a custom logging middleware function.

assignment.title: Task Manager API
assignment.description: Build a full REST API for a Task Manager with GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE routes (using in-memory arrays).

miniProject.title: Course Catalog Backend
miniProject.description: Create APIs to serve course data, handle enrollments, and manage progress updates.

days.badgeCriteria: Successfully test API endpoints using Postman or ThunderClient.

days.title: MongoDB + Mongoose
practicalTasks: Connect an Express app to MongoDB Atlas.
Create a User Mongoose schema and model.
Write a script to seed the database with initial data.

assignment.title: Database Integration for Task API
assignment.description: Upgrade the Day 11 Task Manager API to use MongoDB for persistent data storage.

miniProject.title: Full Stack User Directory
miniProject.description: Build a React frontend and Node/Mongo backend to add, view, and delete users.

days.badgeCriteria: Perform a complex aggregate query in MongoDB.

days.title: Authentication + Full Stack Integration
practicalTasks: Hash a password before saving it to the database.
Generate a JWT upon successful login.
Create a React context to manage user authentication state.

assignment.title: Secure Login System
assignment.description: Implement a full register and login flow where the backend issues a JWT, and the frontend stores it to access protected routes.

miniProject.title: Protected Dashboard Integration
miniProject.description: Connect the React Dashboard (Day 10) to the Course API (Day 11) using JWT authentication.

days.title: Deployment + Portfolio + Final Project
practicalTasks: Deploy the backend API to Render.
Deploy the React frontend to Vercel.
Configure CORS and Environment Variables to link them.

assignment.title: Live App Submission
assignment.description: Submit the live URLs of your fully functioning Full Stack Application.

miniProject.title: Final Portfolio Wrap-up
miniProject.description: Add your new Full Stack project to your developer portfolio.

days.badgeCriteria: Successfully deploy a full stack application live on the internet.

questions.question: Which tag is used for the largest heading?

finalProject.title: Gamified Learning Platform Clone
finalProject.description: Build a learning platform containing Authentication, Dashboard, Courses, Progress Tracking, XP System, Leaderboard, Badges, Admin Dashboard, MongoDB Database, GitHub Repository, Live Deployment.
requirements: Student dashboard displaying XP and Badges
Admin dashboard to view student progress
Deployed frontend to Vercel and backend to Render
